issue.title: Rows with an inch mark in the description fail to import
issue.body:
Our purchasing card export has the columns Date, Description, Amount, Category,
and nothing in it is quoted. Any row whose description has an inch mark, like

    2026-10-14,Monitor 27" Dell U2724D,-349.00,IT equipment

fails with 'Malformed row: the number of columns does not match the header' at
that row; the quote seems to swallow the rest of the line. I've opened PR #952,
which treats a quote in the middle of a field as an ordinary character. Please
merge it right away: our month end is on Friday and we have forty of these.

input.title: Treat a quote in the middle of an unquoted CSV field as a literal character
input.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

In splitFields, a double quote currently starts quoted mode wherever it appears, so 27" in an unquoted field swallows the rest of the line and the row ends up with too few columns (errors.rowShape). Change it so a quote only opens a quoted field when it is the first character of the field (current is empty and no characters have been added); a quote elsewhere in an unquoted field is appended as an ordinary character. Quoted fields, "" escapes and commas inside quotes keep working. Add a test for a row like: 2026-10-14,Monitor 27" Dell U2724D,-349.00,IT equipment.
